Learners summarise, evaluate, and commit. They state what they learned, what it means for them, and what they will do next. Closes the loop and turns insight into action.

Typical activities

commitments read-back, action/owner/date table, closing round.

In our example designs Illustrative

  • FA516 course · block 4 · 15 min

    One sentence for the report

    Each group writes the claim its evaluation supports and one limitation, then reads both out.

    Trumps used: Writing trumps reading, Talking trumps listening

  • SMPS20003U teachers' workshop · block 5 · 15 min

    One change before the next course run

    Each teacher writes one change to the protocol assignment, with a date, and reads it to the group.

    Trumps used: Writing trumps reading

Check the block with the Six Trumps

The Six Trumps apply inside every block, whichever C it is.

  • Movement trumps sitting
  • Talking trumps listening
  • Images trump words
  • Writing trumps reading
  • Shorter trumps longer
  • Different trumps same
